notes: Variant assumption: unilateral dumbbell row with at least partial bench support and a hip/lower-rib pull target, not an unsupported Kroc row or chest-supported bilateral dumbbell row. Direct exact one-arm dumbbell row EMG for all visible back muscles was not found; primary and secondary back roles transfer from seated cable row, prone row, and row-family EMG. Biceps brachii is supported by exact unilateral dumbbell row training evidence but kept secondary because curls produced greater elbow-flexor hypertrophy. External oblique support is included because unilateral row evidence showed higher external oblique activity than bilateral rows; erector spinae is included as support, with the bench-support caveat. Local anatomy mesh mappings resolve for Latissimus dorsi, Teres major, Middle trapezius, Rhomboids, Posterior deltoid, Biceps brachii, Rotator cuff, Erector spinae, and External oblique.
